sources.title: Document URLs
sources.description: Public URLs of the files: DOCX, DOC, ODT, RTF, TXT, HTML, XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, PPTX, PPT, ODP, PNG, JPG, TIFF, SVG. Files in your own Apify key-value store work too: set the store's access to "Anyone with ID can read" and use https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/<store ID>/records/<key>.

pdfA.title: PDF/A (archival)
pdfA.description: Produce PDF/A-2b files for long-term archiving and e-filing portals that require PDF/A.

mergeIntoOne.title: Also merge into one PDF
mergeIntoOne.description: Besides the individual PDFs, return merged.pdf with all converted documents in input order (free).
